title: Aliens plan a shared human-alien civilization (Anakah and Tristan)
summary: Jeffrey Mishlove tells of Aliens plan a shared human-alien civilization (Anakah and Tristan), about present, with memories of other lifetimes at Earth and other planets, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I've done a series of interviews with two individuals who exist in one body. They used the names Anakah and Tristan.
